_aciklama: Aydınlatma metni. Anahtar = kayıt numarası. Sitenin SON eksik sayfası.
_hukuki_karar: GDPR'A ÇEVRİLMEDİ — BİLEREK. TasarımMania İstanbul'da yerleşik bir Türk şirketi; işlediği kişisel veri, sayfanın dili ne olursa olsun 6698 sayılı KVKK'ya tabidir. İngilizce sayfada 'GDPR uygulanır' demek GERÇEK DIŞI bir hukuki iddia olurdu. Bu yüzden hukuki dayanak KVKK olarak korundu; yalnız İngilizce okurun beklediği register ve terimler kullanıldı (data controller, lawful basis, data subject rights). KVKK ile GDPR'ın sözlüğü zaten büyük ölçüde örtüşüyor, çünkü KVKK aynı Avrupa çerçevesinden türemiştir.
_kurum_deseni: KVKK kısaltması korunup açık adı eklendi: 'Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK)' — sitedeki ETBİS/TÜİK/BTK deseninin aynısı. Madde numaraları (5/2, 11) ve 30 günlük süre birebir korundu; hukuki metinde sayı değiştirilmez.
_adres: Posta adresi ÇEVRİLMEDİ. 'Zeytinlik Mah. Pancar Sk. No:19-11, Bakırköy / İstanbul' bir posta adresidir; çevrilirse gönderi ulaşmaz. Aynı gerekçe telefon ve wa.me bağlantısı için de geçerli.
_kullanici_karari: AÇIK KALEM — KULLANICI KARARI GEREKİYOR: AB'den gelen ziyaretçiler için ayrı bir GDPR beyanı eklenecek mi? Bu hukuki/ticari bir karar; uydurulmadı, eklenmedi. Mevcut metin yalnız KVKK'yı anlatıyor ve bu, şirketin gerçek yükümlülüğüdür.
_uzunluk: Kayıt 4/7 (og/twitter description) kaynakta 86 karakter; meta uzunluk kilidinin alt sınırı 120. İngilizcesi KVKK'nın açık adı eklenerek 139 karaktere çıkarıldı — uydurma bilgi eklenmedi, yalnız kısaltma açıldı.

ceviri.22: The privacy notice TasarımMania publishes as data controller under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK): what we process, why, and your rights.
ceviri.26: Under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK"), we at TasarımMania explain in this notice, as data controller, for what purpose and by what method we process your personal data, and what your rights are.
ceviri.29: Within the scope of this notice, your personal data is processed as data controller by
ceviri.31: (Zeytinlik Mah. Pancar Sk. No:19-11, Bakırköy / İstanbul), within the scope and on the terms explained below.
ceviri.33: When you contact us through the quote form or the contact form on our website, or by WhatsApp or telephone, the following personal data may be processed:
ceviri.39: the service you are interested in, the scope of the project, the budget range, and any other information you share on the form or in conversation
ceviri.41: Your personal data is processed solely for the purposes of assessing your request, preparing a quotation suited to you, contacting you, informing you about the services we offer and, where one exists, performing the contractual relationship established between us. Your data is not used for bulk marketing communications (SMS, email newsletters and the like) other than with your explicit consent or at your request.
ceviri.43: Your personal data is not shared with third parties unless there is a legal obligation or it is necessary for the performance of the service (for example, the providers supplying our form and email infrastructure); it is not transferred abroad.
ceviri.44: 5. Method of Collection and Lawful Basis
ceviri.45: Your personal data is collected electronically, transmitted directly by you through the forms on our website, through WhatsApp or telephone conversations, or by email. Under Article 5/2 of KVKK, the processing rests on the ground that it is
ceviri.46: directly related to the assessment of your request and to the establishment or performance of a contract
ceviri.47: and, in cases where your explicit consent has been given, on that explicit consent.
ceviri.49: Under Article 11 of KVKK you have the right to apply to us and: to learn whether your personal data is being processed; to request information if it has been processed; to learn the purpose of the processing and whether the data is used in accordance with that purpose; to know the third parties within Türkiye or abroad to whom it has been transferred; to request its correction if it has been processed incompletely or incorrectly; to request its erasure or destruction within the conditions laid down in KVKK; to request that those operations be notified to the third parties to whom the data has been transferred; to object to a result arising to your detriment through the analysis of the processed data exclusively by automated systems; and to claim compensation for the loss should you suffer loss as a result of unlawful processing.
ceviri.51: To exercise the rights above, you can send us your request, together with information identifying you, through the contact channels below. Your application will be concluded as soon as possible and, depending on its nature, within 30 days at the latest.
